column2: The pdfLaTeX journal templates can't typeset Chinese, Japanese or Korean (they need XeLaTeX or LuaLaTeX with a CJK font, which these templates don't use). Give titles, names and references in Latin script (romanized, with the original in the source data), or prepare the article with a CJK-capable template outside PSG Academic PDF.
